outputs: Generated answers to natural language queries
The model generates answers to questions based on retrieved context or internal knowledge, depending on the relevance of the context.

changes_made.explanation: Removed one output description that was redundant and less precise than the others. Kept all datasets as they are explicitly used for evaluation.
Removed duplicate metrics with explanations in parentheses. Normalized 'accuracy' to 'Accuracy' for consistency.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses LLMs for generation but not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were based on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for question answering tasks. It evaluates adherence (R_Ad) and robustness (R_Ro) metrics extensively across multiple datasets. The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for metrics. The paper uses automatic evaluation exclusively without human or LLM-as-judge assessment.
